resources.string: Research prototype for skin-tone correction. Choose a photo, inspect the selected skin and compare a trial correction. Processing stays on your phone.
Selection cancelled. Your current photo is unchanged.
Detecting the face, selecting skin, estimating ITA/MST and applying the experimental tree locally.
We spotted an area that might be glasses. Choose what you see in the photo.
Compare the trial correction with the working input and inspect the selected skin. Correction quality is not validated.
Something went wrong. Try again or choose a different photo.
We couldn’t find a face. Choose a clear portrait with one person facing the camera.
We found more than one face. Choose a photo with just one person.
We couldn’t clearly see the facial features. Try a closer, well-lit photo with the whole face visible.
We couldn’t find enough visible skin to make an adjustment. Try a photo with more of the face showing.
This photo is too large for your phone to process at its original size. Choose a smaller photo.
We couldn’t open this photo. Select it again from your gallery.
We couldn’t read this file as a photo. Try a different image, such as a JPEG or PNG.
Photo correction couldn’t start. Reopen TrueHue and try again. If it keeps happening, check the app setup.
We couldn’t save the result. Free up some storage and try again.
